answer.direct_answer:
The retrieved evidence does NOT contain the segment-specific marker→ID mapping needed to answer this question. None of the hits report markers or verified ZFIN gene IDs for zebrafish pronephros segments. The top corpus hit (CORPUS-2026-0003) concerns pronephros tubulogenesis via polarity proteins Prkc iota/zeta — not segmentation markers. Other hits are off-topic (anterior-segment/cornea atlas CORPUS-2026-0002; ciliary-mutant penetrance CORPUS-2026-0006). ZFIN and DanioCODE appear only as generic database descriptors with no resolved IDs. The Path-B external search returned zero papers (europepmc=0, pubmed=0), so no literature was fetched to fill the gap.

I therefore cannot assert any marker or gene ID from this bundle without inventing identifiers, which is prohibited. What the field canonically reports (Wingert & Davidson; NOT present in this evidence, offered only as the search target, not as an answer): proximal segments PCT/PST distinguished by slc20a1a and trim2b/slc13a1; distal early by slc12a1; distal late by slc12a3; pronephric duct by gata3. These require verification against ZFIN before use — I am NOT asserting their IDs here because none appear in the evidence.

Recommend a targeted ZFIN lookup for: slc20a1a, slc13a1, slc12a1, slc12a3, gata3.
